evidence_quotes.O: I used the AVS forums settings and the TV had the deepest blacks I have ever seen in an LCD and no loss of shadow detail.
evidence_quotes.C: All the cords, suction mounts, mounting pieces and parts are easily stored there without undue pressure on the GPS pocket.
evidence_quotes.E: I have had many compliments on how they look, and those that I have allowed to listen agree on the sound quality.
evidence_quotes.A: Admittedly I am fairly experienced and would usually set this up manually, but to review for those that aren't in that place I used the setup wizard.
evidence_quotes.N: Well, it took 4 but I have a keeper!
